embedding model

  • CURIE: gmeow:embeddingModel
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embeddingModel
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/graphrag

The model agent that produced this embedding. Two models' embeddings of the same chunk are two Embedding individuals — never merged (P9: machine-derived values are attributed).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Embedding -> gmeow:SoftwareAgent; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:embeddingModel from gmeow:Embedding to gmeow:SoftwareAgent when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Embedding, gmeow:SoftwareAgent
